definitions.gloss: alternative transport service; substitute train service during disruptions
definitions.explanation: a service where passengers can use other train lines or transportation at no extra cost when their normal line is disrupted

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{振替輸送|ふりかえゆそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Alternative transport service is being provided due to an accident.

examples.japanese: {振替輸送|ふりかえゆそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{地下鉄|ちかてつ}→地下鉄：01020_chikatetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}って→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: I took the subway via alternative transport to get to work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まっていた→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{駅員|えきいん}→駅員：05503_ekiin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{振替輸送|ふりかえゆそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: The trains were stopped, so I asked the station staff about alternative transport options.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{振替|ふりかえ}→振替：15942_furikae⟧ (transfer, substitution) + ⟦{輸送|ゆそう}→輸送：04084_yusou⟧ (transport) → substitute transport

USAGE:
When a line stops, the railway announces {振替輸送|ふりかえゆそう}, and passengers can ride the other companies' lines it names without paying again. It generally covers paper tickets and commuter passes (⟦{定期券|ていきけん}→定期券：01064_teikiken⟧); a fare paid from an IC card's stored balance is usually not covered, so check the railway's announcement.
